title: The oxygen uptake capacity of freshwater fish evolves to favour hypoxia tolerance in lentic species but locomotion capacity in lotic species
content:
Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.


Abstract

Oxygen supply capacity (α) is a physiological trait hypothesized to shape the metabolic niche and biogeography of aquatic breathers, yet how natural selection targets α remains unclear. Two key fitness-related traits—locomotor ability and hypoxia tolerance—both depend on α, yet whether this shared physiological basis leads to a functional coupling between these traits, or instead allows them to evolve independently under habitat-specific selection, remains an open question. We therefore hypothesized that divergent selection pressures across flow regimes decouple these two traits, leading to habitat-specific associations between α and each trait. To test this hypothesis, we measured α, hypoxia tolerance and swimming performance in 32 freshwater fish species from lentic and lotic habitats. Our results showed that the relationship between α and each trait varied with habitat type: in lotic species, α was strongly associated with enhanced swimming performance, reflecting selection for supporting the high metabolic demands of prolonged locomotion; in lentic species, α was linked to improved hypoxia tolerance, driven by adaptations to function effectively under low oxygen tensions. Overall, these findings provide insights into the evolutionary lability of α and validate it as a highly flexible, fitness-related trait shaped by habitat-specific selection. This highlights the role of interactions between shared physiological foundations and habitat-specific selection in driving trait divergence, thereby offering a broader framework for understanding how physiological flexibility promotes biodiversity across heterogeneous environments.

摘要

供氧能力(α)被认为是塑造水生生物代谢生态位与生物地理格局的核心生理指标，但自然选择如何作用于该性状尚不明确。运动能力和低氧耐受能力作为两类关键的适应性功能性状，均依赖于α这一共同的生理基础。然而，这一共同生理基础究竟是促成两性状的功能耦合，还是在生境特异性选择压力下各自独立演化，目前仍缺乏清晰的认识。

本研究基于不同水流条件所施加的分异选择压力，提出假说:运动能力与低氧耐受能力可发生功能解耦，并预测α与两性状之间将呈现出生境依赖性的关联模式。为验证该假说，我们选取静水与流水生境中32种淡水鱼类为研究对象，系统测定了其运动能力、低氧耐受能力及供氧能力。

结果显示，α与两性状的关联模式具有明确的生境依赖性。在流水物种中，α与运动能力紧密关联，表现为支持其持续运动所需的高代谢输出；而在静水物种中，α则与提升低氧耐受能力密切关联，表现为其在低氧分压环境下仍维持生理稳态。

本研究揭示了α作为生理性状的进化可塑性，证明α是一高度灵活、受生境特异性选择所塑造的适应性性状。研究进一步阐明α与环境选择压力之间的交互作用驱动功能性状分化的演化机制，并为理解生理灵活性在异质环境背景下促进生物多样性的机制提供了理论框架。
